title: Multi-Service Discount on Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation Mounting
content:
**What is the multi-service discount on a Northgate Delivery & Installation wall-mounting charge?**

At the Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation level, the multi-service discount counts which of the four extra-charge components haul-away, stair carry, extended distance and installation parts kit already have at least one entry on the appointment:

| Extra-charge components with at least one entry on the appointment | Multi-service discount |
|---|---|
| Three or four of them | 15 percent |
| One or two of them | 10 percent |
| None of them | Nothing |

**How is a component counted?**

A component counts once when the appointment's fee history holds at least one entry of that kind; two stair-carry entries still count as one component.

**What does the discount reduce?**

The surcharged amount: the priced labor with any percentage added to it. Percentage discounts on the wall-mounting charge are added together into one total rate, and the surcharged amount is reduced once by that total rate; the discounts do not act successively.

**Hypothetical appointments.**

| Entries on the appointment | Components counted | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| Haul-away, stair carry, extended distance | 3 | 15 percent |
| Two stair-carry entries | 1 | 10 percent |
| Stair carry and installation parts kit | 2 | 10 percent |
| Base delivery only | 0 | Nothing |

A surcharged amount of $300.00 reduced by a total rate of 10 percent becomes $270.00.
